help.title: Help · About
help.purpose: Ship Builder is an offline outfitting bench for Elite Dangerous.
help.topic.buildLinkPrivacy.question: Do share links expose my account?
help.topic.buildLinkPrivacy.answer: No. A link carries only the loadout, encoded in the URL fragment, which your browser does not send to any server. Anyone you hand the whole address to gets that build.
help.topic.accountsUploadsTelemetry.ques: Are there accounts, uploads or telemetry?
help.topic.accountsUploadsTelemetry.answ: None of them. There is no account, no sign-in, no upload, no telemetry and nothing kept on a server.
help.topic.browserPersistence.question: Where are my builds stored?
help.topic.browserPersistence.answer: In this browser, along with your preferences. Clearing site data deletes them, so export or share anything you want to keep.
help.topic.offlineAssets.question: What works offline?
help.topic.offlineAssets.answer: Once installed, the bench and the data bundled with it work with no connection. Ship artwork is there offline only after it has been opened once, and artwork that is missing never blocks the work.
help.topic.completedEngineeringGrades.qu: Why do my engineered stats differ in game?
help.topic.completedEngineeringGrades.an: Rolls vary in quality in game. Here every grade is shown at full quality; an imported partial grade is completed to it, or the import is refused whole before anything opens.
help.topic.hullFactsAndBuildResults.ques: What is a hull fact and what is a build result?
help.topic.hullFactsAndBuildResults.answ: A hull fact belongs to the ship itself; a build result depends on what is fitted to it. Some results also depend on the viewing conditions you declare, such as hardpoints deployed or retracted.
help.topic.almanacOwnership.question: Where do the game values and calculations come from?
help.topic.almanacOwnership.answer: From the bundled Almanac, which supplies the catalogue, the checks and the calculations. Ship Builder neither maintains nor corrects those game values.
